Product Features

  • · Compact standard size: The sideboard measures 140 × 40 × 70 cm and fits perfectly in any dining room, living room or hallway.
  • · Natural wood design in warm brown: The natural-coloured wood look gives the piece of furniture a cosy, modern charm and fits in with many furnishing styles.
  • · Two practical drawers: Top two drawers offer space for small items, documents or table accessories and keep everything tidy.
  • · Sturdy Glass Table Top: The tempered glass table top protects the wood from scratches and stains, is easy to clean and durable.
  • · Stable MDF construction: The body is made of high-quality MDF, is robust and dimensionally stable for long-lasting use.
  • · Safe load-bearing capacity: The body can withstand up to 30 kg, while the glass top can be loaded up to 10 kg – ideal for decorations and table lamps.
  • · Versatile storage options: In addition to the drawers, the lower doors offer additional space for dishes, supplies or utensils.
  • · Modern, easy-to-clean design: The combination of wood look and glass creates a classy look and can be wiped off quickly.
  • · Flexible use as a sideboard, chest of drawers or storage cabinet: Whether as a dining room cabinet, living room chest of drawers or hallway cabinet - this piece of furniture combines functionality and style.
